title: Sienese envoys to the Signoria of Siena, undated slip on a lord's route by Lajatico, Radicondoli and Casole (ASSi Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 25, DECODE R4813)

steps.what: Found the whole busta Concistoro 2308 on DECODE (keys R4746-R4789, letters R4790-R4814, R1858), missed by the 23 Sept scan; downloaded 131 images with the project cookie (the session that worked on all the Concistoro letters).
Viewed and indexed the 43 key records of fasc. 1 (R4746-R4789); compared their alphabets by eye with this letter's signs: none fits.
No. 25 (R4813) transcribed: 496 tokens, 65 point-divided words, 22 signs on a running stroke.
homsolve2 words=1 on no. 25: Latin fails; Italian gives the key unaided (Radichondoli, Chasole, Laiaticho, 'provedere di pane vino biada'); hand fixes H=h, Y=m.

No. 25 L03 'presa' re-checked on the DECODE image for the quotation list: second sign X (r) certain, excluding 'spesa'; blotted first sign has the looped-cross shape of Q (p), not PHI. 'senza altra presa fare' kept (p M, rest H); the opening through 'sarano a Radichondoli' reads continuously.

Split on 14 Oct 2026 from siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): each letter of the bundle has its own key; this entry is no. 25 only. Validation rerun on no. 25 alone (validation.tsv by mk_validation.py).

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 471 tokens, 20 types, it-cinquecento order 4: reading -2.184 per letter; random keys -5.093 (z 6.6); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.224 (mean -3.289, z 28.7); annealer on the real text -2.417. Verdict: pass.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -2.184; polyphony 0.0; 25 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -2.417

outcome.method_basis: homsolve2 (staged annealing, word boundaries, Italian model) gave the key from the ciphertext with no crib; two look-alike signs separated on the image (Y = m, X = r).
outcome.fraction_read_source: transcripts/no25_reading.txt (rev. 2): 477 of 496 cipher signs in words read as Italian; 18 in two unclear words, 1 code sign TH unread.

gaps.item: two unclear words ('s'hadra', 'o chon grediamo', 18 signs) and code sign TH
gaps.detail: each occurs once; no context or sibling fixes them

outcome.notes: Undated slip: an armed lord's route by Lajatico, Radicondoli and Casole into Sienese territory. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from siena1421 under the one-key rule (George Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): each letter of the bundle has its own key; this entry is no. 25 only.

prior.where: Not in print or online (Meister 1902, Cecchini 1952, Senatore 2009 checked); the 1952 inventory calls the bundle 'solo parzialmente decifrate'

human: Set the goal (decipher the 29 letters; try the 42 filed keys first). Instructed that DECODE records marked Decrypted are to be trusted as read.
